verdict.rationale: Recommending a model that fits the user's hardware and task is a fair question for a local model runtime, so the axis applies. The evidence shows a model gallery (Discover page, `local-ai models list`), automatic GPU detection that picks a backend, and a shell agent (`local-ai chat`). None of these is documented as an assistant that recommends which model to download based on hardware and task. Backend auto-selection and gallery browsing are adjacent features, not the recommendation capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on an AI assistant to recommend which local model best fits my hardware and task before I download it
